title: Nutrition, Gut-Brain Axis & Metabolism
subtitle: Deep Dive Audio Series • Human Digestion, Clinical GI Mysteries, Microbiome & Metabolic Toxicology

sections.heading: Human Diet, Digestion & Clinical GI Mysteries

episodes.label: Nucleated Blood, Elementary Bodies, and Vitellogenic Calcium — Companion Bird Hematology & Lead Rubricytosis (V049), Avian Chlamydiosis 3-Site PCR & 45-Day Doxycycline (V050), Reptile Chemistry & Vitellogenesis (V051) & Reptile Coprology Traps (V052)
episodes.notes: One Medicine Exotic, Avian & Herpetological synthesis of companion bird hematology (V049), avian chlamydiosis (V050), reptile hematology/biochemistry (V051), and reptile coprology (V052): Natt-Herrick/Phloxine B, psittacine genus differentials, and lead rubricytosis; C. psittaci zoonosis, 3-site PCR + EBA/IFA, and 45-day doxycycline; chelonian EDTA lysis, lymph dilution, Reptarenavirus, Ca:P/uric acid, and vitellogenic hypercalcemia; and feeder-mouse pseudoparasites, Entamoeba invadens, reptile Cryptosporidium, and chelonian ivermectin toxicity.

episodes.label: Nasopharyngeal Thresholds, Placentomes, and Polybasic Cleavage — Human Respiratory Pathogen NAAT, IS481 Pseudo-Outbreaks & FluPOC (H023), Livestock Pregnancy Ultrasound & Sexing (V045), Swine PRRS Processing Fluids (V047) & Poultry HPAI Furin Cleavage (V048)
episodes.notes: One Medicine Comparative Respiratory Virology, Theriogenology & Biosecurity synthesis of human respiratory NAAT (H023), livestock pregnancy ultrasound (V045), swine PRRS (V047), and poultry avian influenza (V048): ICU lower-tract & adult RSV multispecimen yields, Ct/viability kinetics, the 2006 IS481 pertussis pseudo-outbreak, FluPOC (n=613), and Hamburg forensic autopsies (n=80); bovine fetal sexing & goat hydrometra; PRRS processing fluids & tonsillar persistence; and HPAI polybasic cleavage, BHI swab chemistry, and duck AGID blindness.

episodes.label: Hoof Lamellae, Autumn Photoperiods, and Perineural Blocks — Equine Insulin Dysregulation, IGF-1 Clamp Founder & Karo OST (V040), Equine PPID Autumn ACTH Surge & 10-Min TRH Stim (V041) & Equine Lameness Kinematics, PDNB Scope & Grade 4-5 Fracture Ban (V042)
episodes.notes: One Medicine Equine Endocrinology & Orthopedics synthesis of insulin dysregulation (V040), PPID (V041), and lameness analgesia (V042): Asplin/de Laat IGF-1R hoof clamp proof, Immulite platform cutoffs, Karo OST, and SGLT2 hyperlipemia checks; D2 melanotrope biology, Aug-Oct autumn ACTH peak sensitivity (Copas 2012), 10-min TRH stim, and paired insulin; and Kelmer/Keegan compensatory head-nod laws, the Grade 4-5 fracture radiograph rule, Easter/Schumacher PDNB scope, 5-10m diffusion, and standing foot MRI.

episodes.label: Villi, Low-Protein Cytolysis, and Silicone Gels — Veterinary GI Endoscopy, Corn-Oil Lacteals & Feline Ileal Lymphoma (V036), CSF Lumbar Flow, 30-Min Lysis & Neuro-FIP Cure (V037) & Vet TDM, SST Gel Traps & Feline KBr Asthma Ban (V038)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of veterinary GI endoscopy (V036), CSF analysis (V037), and veterinary TDM (V038): left lateral positioning, Fleet enema ban, corn-oil lacteals, and feline ileal-only T-cell lymphoma (18-39%); pre-tap MRI, lumbar vs. cisternal CSF, 30-60m oncotic lysis rescue (10% serum/Hetastarch), SRMA IgA, GS-441524 neuro-FIP cure, and equine EPM SAG ratios; and plain red-top vs. SST phenobarbital trap, feline KBr/diazepam bans, KBr chloride kinetics, cyclosporine IL-2 mRNA PD, and feline methimazole CKD unmasking.

episodes.label: Half-Lives, Pancreatic Epitopes, and Portal Shunts — Human Therapeutic Drug Monitoring, Vancomycin AUC24 & Winter-Tozer/DigiFab Traps (H056), Canine/Feline Monoclonal Spec cPL/fPL & Triaditis (V025) & Dynamic Paired Bile Acids, Maltese Artifacts & PSS vs. MVD (V026)
episodes.notes: One Medicine synthesis of human therapeutic drug monitoring (H056), canine/feline pancreatic lipase (V025), and dynamic serum bile acid stimulation (V026): phenytoin zero-order kinetics & Winter-Tozer free fraction, digoxin 6-8h & post-DigiFab traps, Bayesian vancomycin AUC24/MIC, and EDTA whole-blood tacrolimus LC-MS/MS; Spec cPL/fPL vs. catalytic lipase failure, feline shared-ampulla Triaditis + B12, cTLI for EPI, and foreign-body bystander cPL; and 12h/2h bile acids, the jaundice ban, Maltese chromogens, and Protein C (<70% PSS vs. >=70% benign MVD).

episodes.label: Scopes, Folds, and Bronchial Stations — Diagnostic Upper GI Endoscopy, GLP-1/PPI Traps & Biopsy Maps (H047), Colonoscopy BBPS, ADR & Cold Snare Quality (H048) & Bronchoscopy, BAL, Cryobiopsy & N3-to-N1 EBUS Staging (H049)
episodes.notes: Clinical Cluster & Interventional Endoscopy synthesis of upper GI endoscopy (H047), colonoscopy quality (H048), and bronchoscopy/EBUS (H049): GLP-1 aspiration and PPI washout rules, 4 normal-mucosa biopsy maps, Lau NEJM 2020, and Forrest IIa hemostasis; BBPS >=2/segment law, Corley ADR (n=314,872), cold snare, tattoo placement, and microscopic colitis; and rigid airway rescue, BAL DAH signatures, clopidogrel TBLB bleeding, COLDICE cryobiopsy, and N3->N2->N1 EBUS-TBNA staging.

episodes.label: The Iron Test Before the School Bell — Non-Anemic Adolescent Iron Deficiency (TSAT 9.5%, Ferritin 10 µg/L), Human Ferroportin–Hepcidin Cryo-EM (6WBV), Alternate-Day Isotope Absorption & Thai vs. Baltimore School Trials
episodes.notes: Separating storage biomarkers from classroom endpoints in iron deficiency without anemia: assay reference intervals vs. WHO/2026 AAP ferritin thresholds, human ferroportin–hepcidin cryo-EM occlusion and Co2+/Fe2+-coupled binding (PDB 6WBV, Kd 210 -> 2.5 nM), Stoffel's erythrocyte stable-isotope absorption trial (16.3% daily vs. 21.8% alternate-day), and Sungthong's Thai school trial (n=397) vs. Bruner's Baltimore verbal-learning RCT (n=81).

episodes.label: The Fat That Stayed in the Bone — Paradoxical Bone Marrow Adiposity in Anorexia Nervosa, 3T L4 vs. Femoral PRESS 1H-MRS, Marrow Adiponectin & Human ADIPOR2 Crystal (5LX9), 12-Month Epiphyseal Divergence & P1NP/β-CTX
episodes.notes: Why vertebral bone marrow fat rises during peripheral fat depletion in anorexia nervosa: Bredella's 3T PRESS 1H-MRS lipid/water ratios vs. areal DXA Z-scores, Cawthorn's Ocn-Wnt10b mouse calorie-restriction adiponectin experiments and human ADIPOR2 zinc-ceramidase structure (PDB 5LX9), Fazeli's 12-month longitudinal surprise (+25.3% femoral epiphyseal marrow fat alongside rising lumbar BMD), and P1NP/beta-CTX/LSC clinical boundaries.

episodes.label: Three Sodium Levels, Two Diets, One Blood Pressure — Controlled DASH-Sodium Feeding Trial (n=412, −8.9 mmHg Path), 24-Hour Urinary Excretion, Human NCC–Hydrochlorothiazide Cryo-EM (9BWT), Urinary Vesicles & GWAS Limits
episodes.notes: Controlled feeding trials meet distal-tubule atomic physiology: Sacks et al.'s (2001) DASH-Sodium parallel-diet/crossover-salt design (n=412, why non-additive interaction yields -8.9 mmHg rather than -12.6 mmHg), energy-scaled sodium density vs. 24h urine potentiometry, human phosphorylated NCC and hydrochlorothiazide cryo-EM (PDB 9BWT), KCl urinary extracellular vesicle readouts, and UK Biobank/CHARGE MTHFS gene-diet slope limits.

episodes.label: The Feed That Changed the Carcass — Swine Ractopamine Stereoisomers at Porcine β1/β2-AR, Dietary Lysine Nitrogen-Retention Factorial Trials, AOAC Tissue LC-MS/MS (m/z 302.1→164.1) & Codex vs. FDA vs. EU Frameworks
episodes.notes: Comparative pharmacology, swine nutrition, and food-residue analytics of ractopamine: Andretta's 3,786-pig meta-analysis, RR/RS/SR/SS stereoisomer selectivity at cloned porcine beta1/beta2 adrenoceptors (Mills 2003) vs. human beta2AR structures (4LDO/3SN6), Ross & Pérez lysine-ractopamine interactions vs. Tous drug-free rations, AOAC 2011.23 parent vs. hydrolyzed LC-MS/MS, pig transport heart rate, and JECFA/FDA/Codex/EFSA regulatory splits.

episodes.label: The Amino Acid at the Brain's Gate — Six-Competitor Plasma Tryptophan Ratio, Human LAT1 Cryo-EM (8J8M/8XPU), TPH2 & PET Tracer Assumptions, Delgado's Remission Relapse Trials (14/21; 8/15 vs. 1/15) & Breakfast Limits
episodes.notes: From plasma amino-acid competition at blood-brain barrier LAT1–CD98hc (PDB 8J8M L-Trp & 8XPU JPH203) to acute tryptophan depletion trials: UHPLC-MS/MS separation of isobaric Leu/Ile, recombinant TPH2 kinetics vs. alpha-[11C]methyl-L-Trp PET assumptions, Delgado's remitted depression crossover (14/21) and SSRI vs. desipramine responder split (8/15 vs. 1/15), and why Wurtman's breakfast study measured plasma ratios rather than mood.

episodes.label: What the Sugar Test Sees — Pediatric Growth Faltering, Claudin-15 Pore Architecture (4P79), Lactulose:Rhamnose Concentration (0.50) vs. Recovery Ratio (0.10), EED Biopsy Morphometry & MAL-ED / WASH Benefits
episodes.notes: Deconstructing dual-sugar intestinal permeability testing in pediatric growth faltering and environmental enteric dysfunction (EED): mouse claudin-15 crystal coordinates (PDB 4P79) vs. neutral sugar probes, why identical 30-90 minute urine bags yield 0.50 by concentration vs. 0.10 by fractional dose recovery on LC-MS/MS, EEDBI duodenal villus morphometry (n=96), MAL-ED (n=1,469), and WASH Benefits Bangladesh (n=4,584).

episodes.label: The Fat Droplet That Wouldn't Let Go — PNPLA3 I148M Droplet Sequestration & ABHD5 Competition, Romeo's Dallas Heart Study Scan, MRI-PDFF vs. FIB-4 & AZD2693 Antisense FORTUNA Trial
episodes.notes: Why knocking out Pnpla3 in mice did not cause fatty liver while human PNPLA3 I148M drives steatohepatitis: Romeo et al. (2008) 1H-MRS genetics, Ser47–Asp166 patatin dyad, ubiquitylation-resistant I148M accumulation on lipid droplets sequestering CGI-58/ABHD5 away from ATGL (Wang et al. 2019), and phase I/IIb GalNAc-ASO AZD2693 MRI-PDFF reductions vs. FORTUNA histologic fibrosis endpoints.

episodes.label: The Gluten Fragment That Changed Its Charge — Celiac TG2 Cys277 Gln→Glu Deamidation, HLA-DQ2.5 Lysβ71 Pocket (1S9V), Irreversible ZED1227 Active-Site Trapping & Gluten-Challenge Biopsy Trials
episodes.notes: Atomic pathogenesis and covalent enzyme inhibition in celiac disease: tissue transglutaminase 2 (TG2) Cys277 thioester deamidation of gliadin glutamine into negatively charged glutamate, HLA-DQ2.5 positively charged P4/P6/P7 pocket anchoring via Lysβ71 (PDB 1S9V), tTG-IgA vs. total IgA and Marsh/villus-height-to-crypt-depth morphometry, and Schuppan et al.'s (2021) NEJM ZED1227 trial.

episodes.label: The Bowel That Learned to Absorb Again — Short-Bowel High-Output Jejunostomy Secretory Losses, GLP-2R Cryo-EM & Teduglutide Ala2→Gly2 DPP-4 Shielding & STEPS Parenteral Weaning
episodes.notes: Intestinal rehabilitation in short-bowel syndrome with end-jejunostomy: net secretory stoma sodium/water balance vs. renal sodium conservation, colonic salvage anatomy, human GLP-2–GLP-2R–Gs cryo-EM structure and teduglutide Ala2→Gly2 DPP-4 resistance, villus height/crypt depth trophic remodeling, and Jeppesen's STEPS randomized parenteral-support reduction trial.

episodes.label: The Fat That Never Got Digested — Exocrine Pancreatic Insufficiency, Fecal Elastase CELA3A/3B ELISA vs. 72-Hour Fat Balance, Lipase-Colipase Lid Opening (1LPB) & Enteric Pancrelipase Trials
episodes.notes: From watery-stool dilution artifacts in fecal elastase testing and Tóth's discovery that 'elastase-1' monoclonals actually measure CELA3B/CELA3A to 72-hour coefficient of fat absorption (CFA) balance math, Egloff's human pancreatic lipase-colipase open-lid crystal structure (PDB 1LPB), enteric-coated pancrelipase pH release kinetics, Whitcomb's 54-patient randomized trial, and fibrosing colonopathy incidence.

episodes.label: The Colon Cancer Signal in the Diet Survey — Fecal Immunochemical Screening Conversion, MGMT Cys145 Suicide Alkyl Transfer, Le Leu's Red-Meat vs. Butyrylated-Starch Rectal Crypt Biopsies & UK Biobank GxE
episodes.notes: Separating stool hemoglobin screening, mucosal adduct biology, and observational nutritional epidemiology: FIT buffer-to-feces (µg Hb/g) conversion, human MGMT Cys145 suicidal O6-methylguanine repair (PDB 1EH6/1T38), Le Leu et al. (2015) randomized high-red-meat ± butyrylated resistant starch rectal biopsy O6MeG adduct trial, and gene-by-diet interaction studies.

episodes.label: The Fructose That Locked Up Phosphate — Hereditary Fructose Intolerance, KHK Fructose-1-Phosphate Trapping vs. ALDOB A149P/A174D Crystal Structures, 31P-MRS Hepatic PME & KHK Inhibition
episodes.notes: From infant post-weaning hypoglycemia, hypophosphatemia, hyperuricemia, and proximal renal Fanconi syndrome in Hereditary Fructose Intolerance to KHK-driven fructose-1-phosphate sequestration, human ALDOB A149P/A174D crystal structures, hepatic 31P-MRS phosphomonoester dynamics, and investigational ketohexokinase inhibition.

episodes.label: When the Brain Burns Ketones — Drug-Resistant Pediatric Epilepsy, SCOT Succinyl-CoA Transferase (3DLX / 1OOY), [11C]Acetoacetate PET, Decanoate AMPA Block & the Neal Trial
episodes.notes: From the 4:1 ketogenic diet ratio (90% energy from fat) and hepatic HMGCS2 ketogenesis to extrahepatic SCOT/OXCT1 glutamyl-CoA thioester catalysis (human apo PDB 3DLX vs. porcine Glu305 intermediate PDB 1OOY), dual [11C]acetoacetate/[18F]FDG brain PET, Chang et al. (2016) decanoic acid GluA2/GluA3 AMPA receptor antagonism, and Neal et al.'s (2008) randomized childhood epilepsy trial (145 randomized, 103 analyzed at 3 months).

episodes.label: The Kidney After the Heat — Collecting-Duct AVP–V2R Cryo-EM (7DW9), AQP2 Ser256 Trafficking, Recurrent Rat Fructose Dehydration vs. Human Exercise Heat Crossovers
episodes.notes: Separating physiological water conservation from tubular injury during heat stress and sweetened rehydration: human arginine vasopressin-V2R-Gs cryo-EM structure (PDB 7DW9) and PKA-driven AQP2 apical exocytosis, Chapman et al. (2020) 12-human heat-exercise soft-drink crossover, García-Arroyo et al. (2017) Wistar rat V1a/V2 conivaptan blockade, and Tourula et al. (2026) hypotonic vs. hypertonic sports drinks.

episodes.label: The Ammonia That Had Nowhere to Go — Postpartum Ornithine Transcarbamylase (OTC) Crisis, PALO vs. Carbamoyl-Phosphate 1OTH/1FVO Structures, Urine Orotate LC-MS/MS & Nitrogen Scavengers
episodes.notes: Postpartum hyperammonemic decompensation in heterozygous Ornithine Transcarbamylase (OTC) deficiency (Arn et al. 1990): pre-analytical ammonia release in warm whole blood, human OTC domain closure around PALO vs. carbamoyl phosphate + norvaline (PDB 1OTH, 1FVO), mitochondrial carbamoyl-phosphate spillover into CAD-driven urinary orotate (m/z 155->111), and phenylacetate/benzoate nitrogen scavenging.

episodes.label: The Allele at the Mediterranean Table — TCF7L2 rs7903146 Islet Chromatin Accessibility, Beta-Catenin 1JPW Interface, PREDIMED Stroke Subgroup & the 2018 Trial Reanalysis
episodes.notes: From intronic TCF7L2 rs7903146 C-to-T open chromatin in human pancreatic islets (Gaulton et al. 2010) and beta-catenin groove binding (PDB 1JPW) to Corella et al.'s (2013) PREDIMED genotype-stratified stroke analysis (n=7,018 / 4,727) and Estruch et al.'s (2018) NEJM retraction-republication accounting for household and clinic non-randomization.

episodes.label: The Marathon, the Microbe, and the Mouse — Boston Marathon Veillonella atypica Stool Signal, Mouse [13C3]Lactate Gut Crossing, Colorectal Propionate & Human Crossover Trials
episodes.notes: Dissecting the Veillonella atypica exercise-microbiome hypothesis (Scheiman et al. 2019 Nature Medicine vs. human crossover trials): relative 16S stool abundance after the Boston Marathon, IV [13C3]lactate mouse cecal tracing at 17–19 minutes, 32-mouse AB-BA treadmill crossover vs. intrarectal propionate instillation, and human randomized endpoints.

episodes.label: The Glucose That Couldn't Leave the Liver — Glycogen Storage Disease Type Ia, ER G6PC1 His176 Phosphohistidine Catalysis vs. SLC37A4, Uncooked Cornstarch & DTX401 Gene Therapy
episodes.notes: From acute fasting hypoglycemia and lactic acidosis in glycogen storage disease type Ia to ER lumenal G6PC1 His176 phosphohistidine hydrolysis vs. SLC37A4 glucose-6-phosphate transport, Grefhorst's ChREBP/LXRalpha mouse blockade vs. human [6,6-2H2]glucose flux, uncooked cornstarch therapy, and AAV8 G6PC1 gene replacement.

episodes.label: The Enzyme That Changed the Fatty Acid Map — FADS1/FADS2 Haplotypes, Delta-5/Delta-6 Desaturase Cytochrome b5 Electron Transfer, [U-13C]ALA Conversion & Greenlandic Selection
episodes.notes: From European lipidomic GWAS of phosphatidylcholine PC 36:4 across FADS1/FADS2 haplotypes A and D (Ameur et al. 2012) to front-end delta-6/delta-5 desaturase HPGG cytochrome b5 architecture, Gillingham et al. [U-13C]ALA tracer recovery in plasma [13C]EPA (3.77% vs. 0.89% at 48h), and Greenlandic Inuit vs. ancient European selection scans (Fumagalli 2015; Mathieson 2018, 2020).

episodes.label: The Same Breakfast, Different Curves — PREDICT 1 Postprandial Glycemic & Lipemic Variability, Interstitial Glucose Oxidase (1CF3), Dual-CGM Discordance & Trial Outcomes
episodes.notes: From PREDICT 1 (Berry et al. 2020, n=1,002) inter-individual postprandial glucose and triglyceride variability to glucose oxidase FAD electrochemistry (PDB 1CF3), simultaneous same-brand vs. cross-brand CGM meal ranking discordance (Merino 2022; Hengist 2025 inpatient duplicate meals), and the Personal Diet Study vs. METHOD randomized trials.

episodes.label: The Sugar That Stayed After the Milk Was Gone — Classic Galactosemia, GALT Ping-Pong His186 Catalysis (5IN3), Endogenous [1-13C]Galactose Production & Aldose Reductase
episodes.notes: Why lifelong dietary galactose restriction saves neonates from acute hepatorenal crisis yet fails to prevent long-term speech and ovarian complications in classic galactosemia: human GALT double-displacement His186 uridylylation (PDB 5IN3), Berry et al. [1-13C]galactose isotope-dilution proof of ~1 g/day endogenous galactose synthesis, and aldose reductase galactitol reduction.

episodes.label: The Monkeys on Two Different Clocks — Wisconsin vs. NIA Rhesus Caloric Restriction Survival, Diet Composition & Feeding Schedules, Sestrin2 5DJ4 & CALERIE
episodes.notes: Reconciling the University of Wisconsin (2009, 2014) and NIA (2012, 2017) rhesus macaque caloric restriction colonies: age at onset, purified 28.5% sucrose ad libitum controls vs. natural-ingredient rationed controls, age-related vs. all-cause Cox hazard ratios, human Sestrin2 leucine-pocket structure (PDB 5DJ4), and the human 2-year CALERIE trial.

episodes.label: The Bile Acid That Missed the Return Trip — Ileal ASBT Reclamation, FXR–FGF19–CYP7A1 Feedback (6HL1), 75SeHCAT Retention, Serum C4 & SINBAD Trial
episodes.notes: Enterohepatic circulation and bile acid malabsorption: apical sodium-dependent bile acid transporter (ASBT/SLC10A2), human FXR ligand-binding domain (PDB 6HL1), ileal FGF19 suppression of hepatic CYP7A1, 7-day 75SeHCAT gamma retention vs. fasting serum 7alpha-hydroxy-4-cholesten-3-one (C4), and colesevelam sequestration in the SINBAD trial.

episodes.label: The Hormone That Heard Less Protein — Dietary Protein Restriction, Hepatocyte FGF21 Induction, Beta-Klotho 5VAQ Docking, FAP Cleavage & Intact vs. Total ELISA
episodes.notes: Endocrine and structural dissection of human FGF21 induction during low-protein and sucrose feeding (Nicolaisen, Ramne, Laeger): C-terminal beta-Klotho docking (PDB 5VAQ), fibroblast activation protein (FAP) Pro171 cleavage separating intact bioactive FGF21 from total immunoreactive FGF21, and central Klb macronutrient preference circuits.

episodes.label: The Fat That Took the Lymph Road — Human Thoracic Duct Cannulation, Enterocyte ApoB-48 Chylomicron Assembly, Lacteal Button Junctions & Lymphatic Prodrugs
episodes.notes: From direct human thoracic duct lymph cannulation (Kayden & Medick 1969; Bloom 1951) and enterocyte sn-2 monoacylglycerol re-esterification onto apoB-48 chylomicrons to lacteal VE-cadherin button vs. zipper junctions and glyceride-mimetic lymphatic prodrug transport bypassing first-pass hepatic extraction.

episodes.label: The Leucine That Wouldn’t Clear — Maple Syrup Urine Disease, BCKDH E1 Phosphorylation (1DTW/1OLS), Isobaric LC-MS/MS Alloisoleucine & Liver Transplant Flux
episodes.notes: Biochemical and analytical dissection of Maple Syrup Urine Disease (MSUD) decompensation: human BCKDH E1 alpha-ketoacid decarboxylation and BCKDK Ser292 phosphorylation (PDB 1DTW/1OLS/4H7Q), chromatographic separation of isobaric leucine, isoleucine, alloisoleucine, and hydroxyproline at m/z 132->86, LAT1 blood-brain barrier competition, IV BCAA-free rescue, and liver transplantation.

episodes.label: The First Calories Back — Refeeding Syndrome, Insulin-Driven Phosphate/Potassium Shifts, PDH E1 ThDP Geometry (1NI4) & Doig ICU Trial
episodes.notes: From starvation to refeeding syndrome in the ICU: insulin-stimulated Na+/K+-ATPase potassium uptake and intracellular phosphate trapping, human pyruvate dehydrogenase E1 thiamine diphosphate (ThDP) active-site geometry (PDB 1NI4), whole-blood ThDP LC-MS/MS assays, diaphragmatic weakness in hypophosphatemia (Aubier 1985), and the Doig et al. (2015) caloric restriction trial.

episodes.label: What the Colon Sends Back — Inulin Fermentation, Eudragit Colon-Targeted [1-13C]SCFAs, Systemic Availability (36% Acetate, 9% Propionate, 2% Butyrate) & FFAR2 8J24
episodes.notes: Atomic and clinical tracing of colonic short-chain fatty acids (Boets et al. 2015, 2017; Bloemen et al. 2009): Bacteroides ovatus inulin cleavage, Roseburia/Faecalibacterium acetate-to-butyrate cross-feeding, Eudragit S100 colon-targeted [1-13C]SCFA capsules with IV [2H]SCFA clearance calibration (36% acetate, 9.2% propionate, 2.4% butyrate systemic availability), and human FFAR2 cryo-EM (PDB 8J24).

episodes.label: The Diet That Went First — Ad Libitum Plant-Based Low-Fat vs. Animal Ketogenic Crossover, Day-15 Sequence Carryover & Ketone/GLP-1 Dynamics
episodes.notes: Methodological and physiological dissection of Hall et al. (2021) and Sciarrillo et al. (2024): how comparing within-person low-fat vs. ketogenic intake (-689 kcal/day) differs from comparing randomized 28-day diet orders (-921 kcal/day for ketogenic-first), and how no-washout crossovers entangle current menu with prior diet history.

episodes.label: The Fat You Burn and the Fat You Lose — NIH Isocaloric Carbohydrate vs. Fat Restriction, 24-Hour Respiratory Quotient & Cumulative Fat Balance
episodes.notes: Metabolic chamber and stoichiometric dissection of Hall et al. (2015) NIH inpatient crossover: why reduced carbohydrate lowered 24-hour RQ and increased fat oxidation (+403 kcal/day) while reduced fat produced greater cumulative net fat loss (89 vs. 53 g/day; 463 vs. 245 g over 6 days) via Livesey-Elia gas-and-nitrogen accounting.

episodes.label: Three Roads to Liver Fat — Chylomicron NEFA Spillover, Multi-Tracer Liver Biopsies, Human FASN 9MJ9 & Beverage De Novo Lipogenesis
episodes.notes: Quantitative isotope dissection of hepatic triacylglycerol sources across three human studies: Piché et al. (2018) chylomicron-derived [U-13C]palmitate spillover, Donnelly et al. (2005) 4-day triple-tracer liver biopsies (59% NEFA, 26% DNL, 15% dietary within accounted fraction), human FASN cryo-EM (PDB 9MJ9), and Geidl-Flueck et al. (2021) sugar-sweetened beverage VLDL-palmitate secretion.

episodes.label: The Carbon in the Next Breath — [U-13C6]Fructose Meal Oxidation, KHK-A 2HW1 Active Site, GC-C-IRMS Plasma Glucose & 7T Hepatic Deuterium Imaging
episodes.notes: Stable-isotope tracing of ingested [U-13C6]fructose in humans (Theytaz et al. 2014): GLUT5 uptake, ketohexokinase KHK-A vs. KHK-C phosphorylation (PDB 2HW1), aldolase B cleavage, GC-C-IRMS 13C-glucose and breath 13CO2 recovery, paired with 7-Tesla hepatic deuterium metabolic imaging (Brunasso et al. 2026).

episodes.label: The Calories That Left the Tray — NIH Ultraprocessed Crossover, Wageningen Texture Eating-Rate Trial & Stool Chemical Oxygen Demand
episodes.notes: Experimental dissection of human energy intake and fecal loss across three controlled feeding trials: Hall et al. (2019) NIH inpatient ultraprocessed crossover (+508 kcal/day), Forde et al. (2026) Wageningen texture-controlled eating-rate crossover (-369 kcal/day), and Corbin et al. (2023) PEG-3350 normalized fecal chemical oxygen demand (+116 kcal/day stool loss).

episodes.label: One Ångström Across the Gut Barrier — Enteric Translocation, TLR4–MD-2 Lipid A Dimerization (3FXI), Microvascular Shunting & Septic Shock
episodes.notes: From an injured intestinal barrier and mesenteric lymph node cultures (Deitch 1989) to the crystal structure of human TLR4-MD-2 bound to E. coli Ra LPS (PDB 3FXI), sublingual microvascular shunting (De Backer 2002), endothelial glycocalyx shedding, and why eritoran MD-2 blockade failed in the Phase III ACCESS sepsis trial.

episodes.label: The Dogs Before the Map — Lawyer's Cave Coastal Alaska Femur, Koster & Stilwell II Intentional Dog Burials (~10,000 BP), Swan Point & Beringian Canids & Pre-Contact Indigenous American Dog Genomes
episodes.notes: Zooarchaeology, radiocarbon reservoir effects, and paleogenomics of early dogs in the Americas: da Silva Coelho et al. (2021) Lawyer's Cave southeast Alaska femur fragment and marine dietary offset, Perri et al.'s directly dated Koster and Stilwell II Illinois dog burials (~10,190-9,630 cal BP), Lanoë et al. (2024) Swan Point subarctic salmon-fed canids, Graf et al. (2026) Beringian base camp, and Ní Leathlobhair et al. (2018) pre-contact American dog clade.

episodes.label: The Lunch That Looked Like an Allergy — Scombroid Histamine Fish Poisoning, Paris Yellowfin Tuna Outbreak (40 Cases, 39/79 Attack Rate), Heat-Stable Histidine Decarboxylation & Supply-Chain Forensics
episodes.notes: Outbreak epidemiology and food toxicology of scombroid histamine fish poisoning: Velut et al.'s (2019) Paris military-canteen yellowfin tuna outbreak (40 cases, 39/79 tuna diners vs. 31-case/63-control questionnaire), bacterial histidine decarboxylation into heat-stable histamine mimicking IgE anaphylaxis, CDC 2006 Louisiana/Tennessee tuna traceback contrasts, and FDA CPG 540.525 surveillance rules.

episodes.label: The Piece the Camera Couldn't See — Normal-Appearing Mucosa in Eosinophilic Esophagitis (169 Eos/HPF, H047), Canine Pseudotumoral Bacterial Gastritis (V036) & Multilevel GI Biopsy Architecture
episodes.notes: One Medicine gastrointestinal endoscopy and mucosal biopsy investigation (H047 & V036): why optically normal human esophageal mucosa can conceal severe eosinophilic esophagitis (169 eosinophils/HPF) unless multilevel biopsies are taken, why canine gastric masses mimicking neoplasia on endoscopy require submucosal histology and special stains, and patchy sampling error.

episodes.label: How a Cell Detects an Energy Shortfall — Carling & Hardie's Shared ACC/HMG-CoA Reductase Kinase (AMPK), Hawley's Thr172 & LKB1–STRAD–MO25 Complex, Sanders's PP2Cα Protection & Gowans's AMP vs. ADP Allostery
episodes.notes: Dissecting the eukaryotic energy sensor AMPK: Carling, Zammit & Hardie's (1987) discovery that a single AMP-responsive kinase inhibits both fatty-acid and sterol synthesis, Hawley et al.'s identification of Thr172 phosphorylation by LKB1–STRAD–MO25, Sanders et al.'s (2007) cell-free proof that AMP binding shields Thr172 from dephosphorylation, and Gowans et al.'s (2013) separation of ADP/AMP protection from AMP allosteric catalysis.

episodes.label: How a Cell Builds Insulin from One Chain — Sanger's Two-Chain Disulfide Puzzle, Steiner & Oyer's 1967 Human Islet Tumor Pulse-Chase Proinsulin Precursor & Equimolar C-Peptide Secretion
episodes.notes: Discovery of prohormone processing: why isolated insulin A and B chains recombine inefficiently in vitro, Steiner & Oyer (1967) identification of single-chain proinsulin in human islet-cell adenoma slices, pulse-chase proof of intracellular proteolytic conversion into two-chain insulin, and Rubenstein, Clark & Steiner (1969) equimolar C-peptide co-secretion enabling clinical distinction between endogenous and exogenous insulin.

episodes.label: How Cells Tie Growth to Available Nutrients — Heitman & Hall's Yeast FPR1/TOR1/TOR2 Rapamycin Mutants, Sabatini & Brown's Mammalian mTOR Affinity Capture & Hara's Amino-Acid Withdrawal Gate
episodes.notes: Discovery of the TOR nutrient-sensing pathway: Heitman, Movva & Hall (1991) genetic screen in Saccharomyces cerevisiae showing rapamycin requires FKBP12 (FPR1) to inhibit TOR1/TOR2, Sabatini et al. (1994) & Brown et al. (1994) biochemical capture of the ~289 kDa mammalian target of rapamycin (mTOR) only when rapamycin is bound to FKBP12, Barbet et al. (1996) starvation-like translation arrest, and Hara et al. (1998) amino-acid gating of insulin-stimulated p70S6K phosphorylation.

episodes.label: How Scientists Followed Carbon Through a Tumor — Warburg's 1927 Artery-Vein Lactate Balance, DeBerardinis's 13C NMR Glioblastoma TCA & Glutaminolysis & Hensley's Intraoperative Lung Tumor Infusions
episodes.notes: From the classical Warburg Effect to human intraoperative stable-isotope tracing: Warburg, Wind & Negelein (1927) aerobic glycolysis across rat tumor vessels, DeBerardinis et al. (2007) 13C NMR isotopomer resolution of simultaneous glycolysis, TCA flux, fatty acid synthesis, and glutamine anaplerosis in glioblastoma cells, and Hensley et al. (2016) intraoperative [U-13C]glucose infusions in human NSCLC patients.

episodes.label: Why an Aroma Can Seem to Come from Your Mouth — Rozin's Dual-Olfaction Juice Test, Dalton's Subthreshold Saccharin-Benzaldehyde Integration, Small's Retronasal fMRI & Blankenship's Optogenetics
episodes.notes: Neurobiology of retronasal olfaction and flavor referral: Rozin (1982) dual-sense hypothesis, Dalton et al. (2000) subthreshold benzaldehyde + saccharin integration (28% lower threshold vs. null MSG control), Small et al. (2005) nasal-cannula fMRI showing route-dependent brain activation for identical vapor concentrations, and Blankenship et al. (2019) gustatory cortex requirement for rapid retronasal learning.

episodes.label: A Message That Traveled in Blood — Bayliss & Starling's 1902 Denervated Jejunal Loop, the Discovery of Secretin, Peptide Sequencing & Receptor Cloning
episodes.notes: Birth of endocrinology and humoral signaling: Bayliss & Starling (1902) surgically denervated jejunal loop acid challenge, intravenous jejunal vs. ileal extract controls Separating pancreatic secretion from vasodepression, Mutt et al. (1970) porcine secretin purification, and Ishihara et al. (1991) secretin receptor cAMP signaling.

episodes.label: The Feast in the Ground — Durrington Walls Near Stonehenge (~2500 BCE), Roasted Pig Bones vs. Dairy/Beef Grooved-Ware Lipids, Multi-Isotope Livestock Mobility & Coprolite Parasites
episodes.notes: Multi-proxy archaeological forensics at Durrington Walls (~2500 BCE): resolving the pig-bone vs. cattle/dairy potsherd lipid paradox through culinary segregation (Craig et al. 2015), five-isotope British livestock provenance (Madgwick et al. 2019), and Mitchell's coprolite paleoparasitology showing poorly cooked bovine/canid-shared tapeworm and capillariid infections.

episodes.label: What the Roman Drain Kept — Roman Latrine Archaeoparasitology, Helminth Eggs, Giardia ELISA & Coprolite Bile-Acid GC-MS
episodes.notes: Multi-proxy archaeoparasitological and biomolecular analysis of Roman sewer and latrine sediments: Ascaris lumbricoides, Trichuris trichiura, Taenia spp., and Diphyllobothrium latum microscopy, Giardia duodenalis and Entamoeba histolytica antigen ELISA, and fecal sterol/bile-acid GC-MS.

episodes.label: The Last Meal in the Bog — Tollund Man's Gut Contents, Barley-Flax-Weed Gruel, Whipworm Eggs & Forensic Reconstruction
episodes.notes: Multi-proxy forensic re-analysis of Tollund Man's large-intestinal contents (Nielsen et al. 2021): plant macrofossils, pollen, non-pollen palynomorphs, ancient DNA, proteins, lipids, Trichuris trichiura eggs, and why threshing waste was intentionally added.
